# SCL: Sync Contractor Page
Logs in to the SCL portal (read-only; credentials from `FULSERVICE_SCL_USER` / `FULSERVICE_SCL_PASSWORD`), posts act 5004 to `ajax/contratista.ajax.php`, saves the raw response to `WEB-INF/data/<catalog>/scl-raw/`, parses the HTML table by header text, and appends a redacted `fsregistrocrudo` row.
## When to use
- The repeating `scl_sync` agent job (scheduled) or an on-demand run from the agent job monitor.
## Output
One `fsejecucionfuente` row per run (success or failed, rows read, error code); progress lines in the agent job run logs. Row data stays in the restricted raw file.
